summary: Today's mix runs from OpenAI's safety pause and AI's growing grip on finance to Ukraine's deadliest drone strike on Russia, a mass typhoon evacuation in China, GTA 6's surprise Netflix debut, and Nolan's new box-office record.

items.title: OpenAI to pause some work on AI model Astra due to security concerns
items.description: OpenAI pauses work on its Astra model after finding it could autonomously find and exploit security vulnerabilities.

items.title: Israel rejects Trump's 15-point plan for Gaza, Netanyahu says
items.description: Netanyahu rejects Trump's Gaza peace plan, vowing Israeli troops won't leave until Hamas fully disarms.

items.title: At least 13 killed in Ukrainian strike on Russia's Tatarstan region, officials say
items.description: A Ukrainian drone strike on Russia's Tatarstan region kills at least 13, among the deadliest such attacks of the war.

items.title: China evacuates one million from homes as massive storm arrives
items.description: Typhoon Dolphin forces the evacuation of a million people as it slams into eastern China, including Shanghai.

items.title: Anthropic is turning Claude Code’s auto mode on by default
items.description: Anthropic will make Claude Code's autonomous auto mode the default for most plans, cutting human oversight of AI coding.

items.title: AI push is putting banks at mercy of tech firms, warns Moody’s
items.description: Moody's warns that banks racing to adopt AI are becoming dangerously dependent on a handful of Silicon Valley tech firms.

items.title: SA premier announces royal commission into AI – as it happened
items.description: South Australia's premier announces a royal commission into artificial intelligence, adding to global regulatory scrutiny.

items.title: Israel accused of weaponising archaeology at ancient West Bank sites
items.description: Israel is accused of weaponising archaeology to justify large-scale land seizures in the occupied West Bank.

items.title: As AI guzzles water and energy, we are already facing a choice: datacentres or homes? | John Harris
items.description: Britain's datacentre boom is pitting AI's voracious water and energy use against the needs of nearby communities.

items.title: Embattled hedge fund Situational Awareness invests $400M in chip startup Source Foundry

items.title: "I'm sure you're going to watch it because everyone is" - GTA 6 premiering on Netflix represents Rockstar "trying new things", says Take-Two boss
items.description: Grand Theft Auto 6's next reveal will premiere on Netflix, an unusual streaming-first move Take-Two says shows Rockstar trying new things.

items.title: SpaceX rocket crashes into the moon as cyberattacks hit U.S. water systems
items.description: Scientists analyse an accidental SpaceX rocket impact on the moon amid a busy week of space and cybersecurity news.

items.title: These startups are chasing the next big thing in LLMs
items.description: A wave of startups is racing to find the next breakthrough beyond today's large language models.

items.title: AI for science needs reasoning, not just data
items.description: Researchers argue AI needs genuine reasoning ability, not just more data, to meaningfully accelerate scientific discovery.

items.title: Historian Jill Lepore says Silicon Valley misreads science fiction and undermines democracy

items.title: Hundreds arrested over French wildfires, but who is to blame?

items.title: Suspected crime boss Kinahan spends first night in custody in Ireland

items.title: 70% of AI revenue comes from OpenAI and Anthropic [video]

items.title: Blizzard is Microsoft's "top performing" studio, thanks largely to Diablo 4 and Overwatch
